exposure: Maternal obesity classification based on ICD-9 codes in hospital discharge records
Maternal obesity classification based on pre-pregnancy BMI from birth certificates
outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of ICD-9 codes for obesity
cohort: The study included 2,329,145 California births between 2007 and 2012.
finding: ICD-9 codes in childbirth discharge records captured only one in five women with pre-pregnancy obesity, leading to misclassification and biased estimates of associations between obesity and pregnancy-related outcomes.
mod_finding: Using ICD-9 codes for obesity classification overestimated the association between maternal obesity and caesarean birth.
